units.rule: distinct (city, districtCode) units, plannedDevelopment===false, summed over the six counties in the P-255 census districtMissCodes arrays

unitParcels.rule: sum of parcels over those units, as counted by the census

cityRows.rule: rows in the six counties' noTableCities arrays (a city spanning two counties has one row per county)

distinctCities.rule: distinct city slugs over those rows

cityParcels.rule: sum of parcels over the no-table city rows
